description.value: Rockweld Farm is a family-owned ethical chicken and egg operation run by Tim and Flo Rempel, featuring an on-farm store in Abbotsford's agricultural heartland. The store sells free-roam, non-medicated chicken in a remarkable range of forms — whole birds, cuts, sausages, pot pies, smoked meats, and bone stock — alongside organic beef, cheese, assorted fish, and locally grown frozen berries. Cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley farm country will find a genuine farm-direct stop with an unusually broad selection of locally sourced foods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Rockweld Farm is an active on-farm retail store at 34205 Townshipline Road, Abbotsford, matching OSM address and phone (604.859.1199). The site details a wide range of chicken products, eggs, organic beef, cheese, fish, and frozen berries sold from the farm store, supporting the 'Groceries' category. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number (604.217.4500) not present in OSM.
Website lists the fax number as 604.859.1199, the same as the main phone line, which may indicate an outdated listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational on-farm store with a functioning website, confirmed address, and a broad range of locally produced foods — a useful stop for touring cyclists in the Abbotsford area.
